brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) with bottom solid cover (cover:0,0,0;full;bottom), top cover, and 6 solid caps on all side faces (cap:0,0,0;*;150/210/270/30/330/90) — all openings enclosed, meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover is variant full type cable (cover:0,0,0;full;top stem cable) — designed with cable routing slots to pass charging cable through closed box; staged with cable-coil prop (prop:5) beside phone

finish.summary: Built single-cell closed box on full hex base with solid bottom cover, cable-type top cover, and six solid side caps. House rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied, mesh clear. Phone on lid and coiled cable beside it stage use as phone charging station with cable entry.

events.text: Your charging box is next — I'll build a closed box with a cable-ready cover.
